text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you here for the library too? I 
take it you're after the new arrivals 
coming in today?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: No? I was just passing by.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If it's those books, I have already looked 
through the original texts.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(Falling behind again... even in a place 
like this...\n...No! I'm not giving up 
yet...!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that's right. I came across a 
fascinating research paper— would you care 
to discuss it with me?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I thought I might be able to have a 
meaningful discussion with you. Provided 
you've read it, of course.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu, indeed. I was just thinking of 
taking a break myself."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Looks like it's going to be a fun tea 
party, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ......Yes! Let's both make it a fun time.
